## Review checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and linked to an issue or work package.
- [ ] Tests cover new or changed critical behavior where practical.
- [ ] Documentation, screenshots, schemas, and examples are updated where needed.
- [ ] No secrets, credentials, maintainer-local paths, or unnecessary private network data are included.
- [ ] Logging and error messages do not expose sensitive information.
- [ ] Release notes or changelog impact has been considered.
